description: Watch movies, series, lessons and personal recordings in the mvmOS desktop or an Apps Hub browser page. Administrators upload files or folders into a shared library; each profile keeps independent progress, favourites, history and collections. Filename recognition identifies movie years and season/episode numbers. Optional online suggestions come directly from TVmaze and Wikipedia, without user API keys. This initial version plays browser-compatible files directly and supports external SRT and WebVTT subtitles. It does not transcode video or extract embedded subtitles. Jellyfin integration is planned and is not included in this version.
capabilities: Desktop and responsive Apps Hub interface with a shared video library.
Batch and folder uploads in retry-safe chunks, with filename and folder recognition.
Independent watching progress, completion, favourites and personal collections.
Browser playback with seeking, speed, fullscreen and external SRT/WebVTT subtitles.
TVmaze series suggestions and season/episode information, including unavailable episodes.
Wikipedia movie suggestions with source attribution and selected-field confirmation.
Administrator editing and cover/subtitle management without resetting viewer progress.
No separate service, FFmpeg, system backend folder or additional server package required.
requirements: A browser that supports the uploaded video's container and audio/video codecs.
